## Three kinds of analytics

Sorted by the question each answers, not by difficulty.

<!-- Slide-local styling for the analytics maturity stack (used only here;
     generic reusable rules live in styles.css). Replaces analytics_stack.png:
     native so tags stay readable and the deck's dark theme applies. -->
<style>
.analytics-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35em;
  width: 82%;
  margin: 0.4em auto 0;
}
.analytics-stack .layer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 5.6em 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 1em;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.55em 1em;
}
.analytics-stack .layer .name { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15em; line-height: 1.05; }
.analytics-stack .layer .q { font-style: italic; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); }
.analytics-stack .layer .tags { font-size: 0.86em; letter-spacing: 0.02em; opacity: 0.92; margin-top: 0.12em; }
.analytics-stack .rests {
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-left: 1.4em;
  font-size: 0.86em;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  line-height: 1;
}
.analytics-stack .prescriptive { border-color: #7b5cc4; background: rgba(123, 92, 196, 0.16); }
.analytics-stack .prescriptive .name, .analytics-stack .prescriptive .tags { color: #b39ae0; }
.analytics-stack .predictive { border-color: #3c8cc8; background: rgba(60, 140, 200, 0.14); }
.analytics-stack .predictive .name, .analytics-stack .predictive .tags { color: #6fb6e6; }
.analytics-stack .descriptive { border-color: #e69138; background: rgba(230, 145, 56, 0.14); }

</style>

::: {.analytics-stack}
<div class="layer prescriptive">
<div class="name">Prescriptive</div>
<div><span class="q">what should we do?</span><div class="tags">optimization · decisions</div></div>
</div>
<div class="rests">▲ rests on</div>
<div class="layer predictive">
<div class="name">Predictive</div>
<div><span class="q">what will happen?</span><div class="tags">forecasting · machine learning</div></div>
</div>
<div class="rests">▲ rests on</div>
<div class="layer descriptive">
<div class="name">Descriptive</div>
<div><span class="q">what happened?</span><div class="tags">data · reporting · dashboards</div></div>
</div>
:::

::: {.fragment .platypus-info}
A **stack, not a menu**: a prescriptive decision rests on a prediction, which rests on a description of what is going on. Optimization is the top layer.
:::

<div class="subtitle">The INFORMS Analytics Framework: from vague business question to sustained decision system.</div>

<div class="layout">
<div>
<div class="stage-grid">
<div class="head">#</div><div class="head">Stage</div><div class="head">Main job</div>
<div class="num">1</div><div class="stage">Business Problem Framing</div><div>Find a question whose answer is worth money.</div>
<div class="num">2</div><div class="stage">Analytics Problem Framing</div><div>Define drivers, KPIs, assumptions, and baseline.</div>
<div class="num">3</div><div class="stage">Data</div><div>Identify, acquire, clean, validate, document.</div>
<div class="num">4</div><div class="stage">Methodology</div><div>Choose the approach and architecture.</div>
<div class="num focus">5</div><div class="stage focus">Model Building</div><div class="focus">Variables, objective, constraints, calibration.</div>
<div class="num">6</div><div class="stage">Deployment</div><div>Ship the system and the work change around it.</div>
<div class="num">7</div><div class="stage">Lifecycle Management</div><div>Monitor, recalibrate, train, and keep value alive.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="side">
<div class="takeaway fragment">
Building the model is <strong>stage 5</strong>: often just <strong>10-15%</strong> of project time, and rarely the stage that decides the outcome.
</div>
